title: 2020 story of an edtech startup — 1: What happened?
body_markdown:
### Story of an edtech startup in 2020 — 1: What happened?


One of the greatest tragedies experienced by recent generations came into our lives 9 months ago. It left behind many irreversible losses, as in past disasters. On the other hand, it brought many innovations to our lives. While great minds such as Özlem Türeci and Uğur Şahin developed a vaccine at a pace unseen in the history of medicine to get out of this disaster as quickly as possible, another group of entrepreneurs made people’s lives easier with their products that are not directly fighting against Covid-19. Innovation has undoubtedly made this period more livable and these advancements will continue to impact people’s lives post-Covid.


Education experienced a more drastic change in a few months than it had in the previous 250 years. At Kunduz, we have felt a sense of responsibility for being part of this disruptive change.


### So what have we achieved?


✔︎ **In 1 year,** the number of paying students at Kunduz **quadrupled** .


✔︎ Now, **1 million questions** are solved **per week on Kunduz** . This number was 500 thousand 1 month ago. Kunduz keeps growing its momentum every day.


✔︎ Many new friends joined the Kunduz team during this period. In one year **,** we **doubled our size** **in 3 different countries** .


✔︎ **Kunduz Mumbai Team** strengthened its presence in India. Our 10 amazing friends in Mumbai are following the first steps of our success in Turkey.


✔︎ **Andreessen Horowitz**[listed](https://a16z.com/2020/10/16/next-gen-edtech/) **Kunduz among the most promising players of the next wave** of online learning in the United States in its blog post **.**


✔︎ Kunduz is nominated for **Startup** **of the Year, Mobile Application** **of the Year** , and **Entrepreneur of the** **Year** in Turkey by people on ****[Webrazzi](http://webrazzi.com/odul) ’s annual technology awards in **2020** .


Barış coding on one of the more stressful days in early 2020


### What did we work on?


As edtech ended up becoming the one and only remedy for formal education in the very first days of Covid-19, we looked to our students and reprioritized what is next to build to make students’ lives easier. The reshuffle of the priorities and turbo-charged user adoption accelerated our pipeline for the past 9 months:


🚀 **Daily mock tests all across Turkey:** One of the critical consequences of students being away from school was not having frequent mock tests during the last 2 months of test prep. Thanks to the generosity of the publishers we partner with, students were able to see their nation-wide ranking on a daily basis for free.


🚀 **Online tutoring:** More secure and affordable tutoring was another need we heard from students. This year, our students had the opportunity to have online 1-on-1 sessions with the best tutors in the Kunduz network, at half the price of the most affordable lesson on the market.


🚀 **Kunduz the Coach:** One of the most valuable lessons from the past 5 years was how crucial it is for students to survive this stressful period in the psychologically healthiest way. We are now offering our experience in this field with our 1-on-1 coaching service for a small price of only $4 per session.


🚀 **Coming soon:** With Kunduz, students will soon be able to complete practice tests and read class notes. This new version will be released with the purpose of building a smarter recommendation engine over time to offer the next-gen adaptive learning technology — something that other providers have continued to fall short on. We know test prep is a race against time. We want Kunduz students to spend their time in the most productive way possible because every minute devoted to a question is a golden opportunity for learning. *This will be Kunduz’s flagship product in 3 years.*


🚀 **International expansion:** We have finetuned our products to the specific market needs in India and Turkey. We are excited to share that recently, we have started testing out the US market. We are certain that success in North America is going to be one of the highlights of 2021 version of this post.


One of the last meetings of 2019 in the Istanbul Office


### To whom are we grateful? Why?


### To our teammates


> We know that achieving all of this is only possible when talented and determined people put their hearts together.


We wouldn’t be here if it wasn’t for our teammates who’ve joined us in this journey and believed in our dream as much as we do — especially at a time everything was built around a few hypotheses supported by not-so-sound assumptions. Every teammate who joined an early-stage startup is a hero for following a path that is so vague for everyone else.


In Kunduz, the discussion has never been about whether we are capable of doing it. It has only been about how long it will take and what the priority is. These simple distinctions in the everyday language we use remind us of the confidence for what our team is capable of and emphasizes the trust placed in one another each and every day.


Full-time or part-time; developer or operator; whether in Turkey, India, or United States, we are eternally grateful to each of our 87 teammates. If there is one thing that we are more confident about than our business or numbers, it is that this A+ team is the architect of what we are proud of sharing with you right now. If it wasn’t for all of us, Kunduz would not have come this far. If it wasn’t for all of us, this adventure would not be as fun.


### To our investors


> Because they believe in Kunduz’s mission and continue to support us in a domain like edtech, a historically luckluster sector of the tech world.


In the beginning, investors in Turkey found various reasons for not investing in Kunduz, but luckily, we found investors in Silicon Valley who believed in us. They repeatedly show their support when we need them and even though they do not have even the slighted connection to Turkey, they still recognize and care about Kunduz’s social impact and potential for long-term success as a business. We will never forget that.


### To our tutors


> Because they re-create Kunduz every day by sharing our mission.


We are truly grateful to our tutors. They have lived and breathed Kunduz’s mission to make education affordable from day one even though they knew that each could likely find more lucrative opportunities than what Kunduz was offering them. Each of them has been our brand ambassadors day and night, along with the thousands of questions they have helped students solve.


### To our friends and families


They have supported us in this journey in different roles and ways. Each of them has believed in us and motivated us to go that extra mile, which is essential for surviving as a startup. Their place in our hearts was rooted more and more every day with their continuous support.


**We will share our second post about our learnings as a startup from this year in a few days.** We hope that the principles that we believe brought Kunduz to this point from 2020 will inspire other entrepreneurs as well, especially those in emerging markets and in edtech.


Entrepreneurship does not have a school or training that could fit in a curriculum. We have been inspired by fellow entrepreneurs’ stories and learned from their mistakes saving us precious time and money. We owe many of our accomplishments to others as we have learned from their journeys and believe the best way to pay it forward is to share our own stories, successes, and of course, rookie mistakes. 2021 will be the start of this *resolution* for Kunduz and we hope you join us on this ride.


You can reach us atfounders@kunduz.com for your questions and suggestions.


Wish you all a better year than the last 🎢


Barış, Başar & Melih


This article was originally written to share our story with fellow and future entrepreneurs in Turkey. **A quick thanks to Google Translate for doing the groundwork of this translation from Turkish to English.** Impressive to see how much progress it made since the first release of the Turkish — English translation capability 👏🏼
